entities.summary: Antonio Maria Vassalli Eandi was an Italian abbot, physicist, mathematician and teacher. He was a pupil of the physics professor Giovanni Battista Beccaria. Vassalli Eandi wrote on a range of topics including meteorology, plants, and electricity.
